title: Hybridisation and geometry
basic_overview: Hybridisation is a valence-bond model used to rationalise directional bonding.

extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. Count electron domains. 2. Choose hybrid set. 3. Place σ bonds/lone pairs. 4. Reserve unhybridised orbitals for π bonds.
extra_info_content.factors: Hybridisation is a model; MO theory treats delocalisation more completely.
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
